draft.line_numbering: One-based LF-separated raw text lines; form-feed characters do not add lines.

requirements.paraphrase: Coverage is the record set asserted by the claim.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: A finite, named domain and half-open UTC window are required by this local experiment; the draft does not prescribe a closure algorithm.

requirements.paraphrase: Materiality is relative to the conduct or assertion at issue.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: Party identities and their materiality are stipulated fixture facts, not discovered or externally certified.

requirements.paraphrase: Name the claimed domain and omission-revealing mechanism; valid disclosed artifacts do not establish wider completeness.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: Missing domain or detector leaves the completeness appraisal INDETERMINATE; a separate reporting-conformance check is not implemented. Omission causes are not inferred.

requirements.paraphrase: Same-party operation or input selection needs an independently appraised basis. Its absence alone is not UNSATISFIED.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: A separately controlled exhaustive counterparty index is the only basis implemented. Material-party input selection is disqualifying even with a different operator.

requirements.paraphrase: Retain completed authority, result/domain binding, extent and temporal appraisals before SATISFIED.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: A local fixture policy defines exact scope, version+digest binding, trusted counterparty authority, and full-window coverage. Neither digest nor matching identifiers proves truth or independence.

requirements.paraphrase: Demonstrate both unestablished and independently appraised established outcomes under one revision and prior expectations.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: Pairs and prior local digests will be retained. No externally timed commitment or independently controlled exercise evidence exists; full exercise conformance is NOT claimed.

requirements.paraphrase: Keep satisfied, unsatisfied, indeterminate and not-evaluated distinct.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: Uppercase underscore spellings are local JSON tokens. A proven missing member of the independently enumerated domain is UNSATISFIED under the local equality predicate; unavailable evidence is INDETERMINATE.

requirements.paraphrase: Record check time, carried evidence times, and distinguish capability from an unattempted check.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: A fixed replay instant gives deterministic output; the actual wall-clock execution interval is recorded separately. Capability is supplied explicitly in the evaluation plan, never inferred from resolver failure.

requirements.paraphrase: A refuted predicate and unestablished completeness are separate verdicts.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: An optional at-most-once check counts only fixture-authenticated disclosed occurrences; it never reads scenario truth.

requirements.paraphrase: Missing independent coverage is not proof of omission; the requirements do not establish protocol truth or deployment security.
requirements.local_interpretation_or_limit: Scenario-only withheld records are kept outside the evaluator input. The test author is not an independent evidence root.
